prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: empty environment background for an original Chinese infinite-flow survival RPG main-god sanctuary, used behind NPC sprites and controls on a 390x740 mobile screen.
Primary request: Generate one original portrait 1024x1536 hand-painted 2D game environment.
Scene/backdrop: a broad, quiet obsidian and charcoal stone courtyard within an ancient sanctuary of bronze columns. A symmetric architectural axis leads to a restrained altar near the upper center, with a small distant warm-gold floating main-god light above it.
Style/medium: grounded painted dark fantasy, with restrained retro-science-fiction influence; clearly illustrated game environment, not a photograph.
Composition/framing: elevated 30-degree near-orthographic camera. Spacious, plain stone floor across the middle and foreground; the middle 60 percent intentionally remains open for overlaid NPC sprites and controls. All major architecture stays within a mobile portrait crop. No dramatic stairs covering the center; no tall foreground obstruction.
Lighting/mood: muted oxidized-cyan side lighting, subtle old-gold edges, soft dusty haze, quiet and solemn.
Materials/textures: worn stone and aged bronze, bronze inlay rings in the floor, subtle detail without clutter.
Constraints: empty environment only; no people, NPCs, monsters, or any additional objects. No interface, buttons, cards, text, glyph letters, numbers, logo, or watermark. No neon, no cyberpunk. Opaque background.
